text: The purpose of this report is to seek further instruction in relation to a development application that has been appealed to the Ontario Land Tribunal (the "OLT") as Tribunal case number PL200329. A 10-day hearing relating to the development proposal is scheduled to commence on March 21, 2022.

City Council on March 9, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 1, 2022) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (March 1, 2022) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 1, 2022) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege. The confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 1, 2022) from the City Solicitor, were adopted by City Council and are now public as follows: 1.
